name: Mysuru
summary: A compact palace city. Brindavan Gardens and Srirangapatna are 15-20 km out and need a half day.

attractions.name: Mysore Palace
attractions.description: Indo-Saracenic palace of the Wadiyar dynasty.

attractions.name: Chamundeshwari Temple
attractions.description: Hilltop temple on Chamundi Hill with views of the city.

attractions.name: Brindavan Gardens
attractions.description: Terraced gardens below the KRS dam; busiest in the evening.

attractions.name: Mysuru Zoo
attractions.description: Large, shaded zoological garden. Closed on Tuesdays in this dataset.

attractions.name: Rail Museum
attractions.description: Open-air collection of locomotives and royal carriages. Closed on Mondays in this dataset.

attractions.name: Jaganmohan Palace Art Gallery
attractions.description: Paintings, including works by Raja Ravi Varma.

attractions.name: Karanji Lake
attractions.description: Lake with a walk-through aviary and butterfly park.

attractions.name: Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangapatna
attractions.description: Island-town temple; closed in the afternoon.

attractions.name: Daria Daulat Bagh
attractions.description: Tipu Sultan's summer palace with painted walls. Closed on Fridays in this dataset.
